Name: (CP Livestock) Giant Rabbit
Author: Luzze42
Description:
For all of you, who can't get enough of rabbits!


This mod adds giant rabbits for sale at Marnies'.

Just as their smaller cousins they go into the deluxe coop. They take a little longer to grow up and drop wool (although less frequently) and rabbit feet. Their lesser fur shedding is made up for by archieving higher sale prices (and higher meat amounts, if you're using AHM).

If you are [b]not using AHM[/b], just delete the [AHM]-subfolder from this mod, otherwise you will get a little red error (which really doesn't do any harm).


Do you like this mod? If yes, I'd be thrilled if you could show me screenshots of how they look on your farm =) Otherwise I'm always open for feedback!
